cards.title: Moon Muffin Market Detail Sprinkle
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable notebook-margin revision card for adding one tiny market detail to a fictional moon muffin line: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, fold the margin strip beside a blank page, and name one made-up muffin stall together: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write one short market line, then use the margin to add a small color, shape, or smell detail: ____________________.
cards.marginPrompt: Margin prompt: Draw or write one tiny moon muffin detail beside the line: ____________________.
cards.draftLinePrompt: Draft line: The Moon Muffin Market opened when ____________________.
cards.revisionMovePrompt: Revision move: Add one exact detail that makes the muffin easy to picture: ____________________.
cards.newLinePrompt: New line: The Moon Muffin Market opened when ____________________.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Check back: Point to the new detail and say what picture it adds: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Add only one margin word before rewriting the line: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Use this card again with a new pretend moon muffin detail: ____________________.

cards.title: Puddle Planet Parcel Word Swap
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable notebook-margin revision card for swapping one plain parcel word in a fictional puddle post office line: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, place it beside notebook paper, and circle one plain word the writer can trade: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write a puddle parcel line, choose one plain word, and swap it for a juicier pretend word: ____________________.
cards.marginPrompt: Margin prompt: List two replacement words for the puddle parcel: ____________________.
cards.draftLinePrompt: Draft line: The puddle parcel moved across the counter and ____________________.

cards.newLinePrompt: New line: The puddle parcel ____________________ across the counter and ____________________.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Check back: Underline the swapped word and check that the sentence still makes sense: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Whisper the two word choices to an adult, then write one: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Try one more word swap for a new Puddle Planet parcel: ____________________.

cards.title: Buttonwood Library Train Sentence Stretch
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable notebook-margin revision card for stretching a fictional library train sentence with one useful clue: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, draw a tiny train-car box in the notebook margin, and choose where the extra clue can ride: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write one Buttonwood Library Train sentence, then stretch it by adding where, when, or why: ____________________.
cards.marginPrompt: Margin prompt: Pick one stretch clue for the train car: where, when, or why: ____________________.
cards.draftLinePrompt: Draft line: The Buttonwood Library Train rolled past ____________________.
cards.revisionMovePrompt: Revision move: Stretch the sentence with one clue from the margin box: ____________________.
cards.newLinePrompt: New line: The Buttonwood Library Train rolled past ____________________ because ____________________.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Check back: Read both lines and circle the one that gives the reader more help: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Write only the extra clue in the margin before the full new line: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Stretch another library train sentence with a different clue: ____________________.

cards.title: Button Bakery Map Mix-Up Order Fix

cards.adultSetup: Print the card, draw three crumb dots in the margin, and ask the writer to number what happens first, next, and last: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write a mixed-up bakery sentence, then number the margin crumbs and rewrite the events in a smoother order: ____________________.
cards.marginPrompt: Margin prompt: Number the three paper crumb clues first, next, and last: ____________________.
cards.draftLinePrompt: Draft line: The map was fixed after the button tray moved and the baker found ____________________.
cards.revisionMovePrompt: Revision move: Put the bakery events in the order a reader needs: ____________________.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Check back: Trace the three crumb numbers and make sure no step is missing: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Number only the crumbs first, then write the new first step: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Use this order card for another pretend Button Bakery map mix-up: ____________________.

cards.kidDirection: Write one weather-window line, then revise it so the mood feels clearer through color, sound, or motion: ____________________.

cards.draftLinePrompt: Draft line: The Teacup Town weather window showed ____________________.
